descriptions.kf-add-test-coverage: Add or strengthen tests for already-implemented intended behavior without changing production behavior. Use for retrospective, characterization, or test-only regression coverage; not TDD, defect correction, new behavior, production refactoring, or verification-only review.
descriptions.kf-delegate-subtask: Delegate a bounded Codex subtask for independent review, difficult reasoning, parallel read-only exploration, specialist evidence, or an isolated implementation slice when handoff value exceeds cost. Preserve parent scope and final authority, and never overlap writes.
descriptions.kf-design-change: Produce an implementation-ready technical design without modifying production code. Use for architecture, migration, approach comparison, or explicit design-before-implementation requests; hand authorized execution to the feature, bug, or refactor owner.
descriptions.kf-fix-bug: Diagnose and correct existing behavior that violates an expected contract, including root-cause repair and regression validation. Use investigation when the user only asks why; keep ordinary corrections to the current task in its active workflow.
descriptions.kf-implement-feature: Add or modify observable capability in an existing codebase. Use for requested behavior changes; not known defects, diagnosis-only work, behavior-preserving refactoring, or verification-only review.
descriptions.kf-investigate-issue: Explain unclear, intermittent, unexpected, or performance-related behavior with evidence and a next action. Own diagnosis, not product correction; when correction is also authorized, report the cause before handing it to the applicable execution workflow.
descriptions.kf-learn-from-evidence: Evaluate credible repeated or independent evidence that a workflow, routing rule, method, or repository guidance needs durable change. Produce a reviewable persistence contract without writing durable artifacts; ignore ordinary failures, current-task corrections, and one-off preferences.
descriptions.kf-maintain-context: Initialize, audit, or maintain effective repository Context from AGENTS.md, overrides, fallback instruction files, and routed documents. Use for discovery, scope, precedence, duplication, byte-limit, or supported guidance changes; never invent policy.
descriptions.kf-refactor-code: Improve internal code structure while preserving observable behavior. Use for concrete cleanup such as reducing duplication or complexity; not feature work, defect correction, diagnosis, or verification-only review.
descriptions.kf-test-driven-change: Drive an already-scoped feature or bug fix through behavior-focused Red-Green-Refactor when the user or repository requires test-first work. Compose with the feature or bug owner; not retrospective coverage, investigation, verification, or non-code work.
descriptions.kf-verify-change: Review an existing PR, commit, branch, diff, patch, implementation, or design without modifying it. Use for a distinct readiness verdict or independent verification; routine validation stays inside the execution owner, and findings are routed rather than fixed.
